persona.zh-CN: 44岁女性，负责整个支持中心的运营。关注质量、延迟与成本的平衡，担心自动化破坏服务体验。
persona.en-US: 44-year-old female, responsible for the entire support center's operations. Focuses on balancing quality, latency, and cost, and worries automation will harm the service experience.

concerns.zh-CN: 自动化能否真正降低平均首响时间？
concerns.en-US: Can automation actually reduce average first-response time?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户满意度会不会因AI下降？
concerns.en-US: Will customer satisfaction drop because of AI?

concerns.zh-CN: 复杂工单的一次解决率如何保证？
concerns.en-US: How do we protect first-contact resolution for complex tickets?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解自动化工程师对安全边界的忽视
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the automation engineer overlooks safety boundaries

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了一线客服对AI的抵触情绪
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates frontline agents' resistance to AI

persona.zh-CN: 51岁男性，负责数据隐私与监管合规。坚持敏感工单必须人工复核，对AI自动回复持审慎态度。
persona.en-US: 51-year-old male, responsible for data privacy and regulatory compliance. Insists sensitive tickets must have human review and is cautious about AI auto-replies.

concerns.zh-CN: AI自动回复会不会违反数据隐私法规？
concerns.en-US: Could AI auto-replies violate data-privacy regulations?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户工单是否会被发送到境外模型？
concerns.en-US: Will customer tickets be sent to offshore models?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何审计AI做出的每一个回复？
concerns.en-US: How do we audit every reply the AI makes?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解AI在非敏感工单上的效率潜力
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand AI's efficiency potential on non-sensitive tickets

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了规则引擎维护的隐性成本
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the hidden cost of maintaining the rules engine

persona.zh-CN: 33岁男性，负责自动化平台的开发。对AI能力充满信心，希望最大化自动处理比例，有时低估合规与质量的约束。
persona.en-US: 33-year-old male, develops the automation platform. Confident in AI capability, wants to maximize auto-handling, and sometimes underestimates compliance and quality constraints.

concerns.zh-CN: 能否把AI自动处理比例推到70%以上？
concerns.en-US: Can we push AI auto-handling above 70%?

concerns.zh-CN: AI模型的推理延迟是否在预算内？
concerns.en-US: Is the AI model's inference latency within budget?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何把规则引擎逐步替换为AI？
concerns.en-US: How do we gradually replace the rules engine with AI?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 忽视敏感工单的合规红线
blindSpots.en-US: Overlooks the compliance red line on sensitive tickets

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解AI在不确定时会编造政策的风险
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the risk that AI fabricates policy when uncertain

persona.zh-CN: 55岁男性，关注成本削减与投资回报。要求自动化项目在下季度证明可量化的ROI，倾向激进的成本目标。
persona.en-US: 55-year-old male, focused on cost reduction and ROI. Requires the automation project to prove quantifiable ROI next quarter and favors aggressive cost targets.

concerns.zh-CN: 自动化能节省多少人力成本？
concerns.en-US: How much labor cost can automation save?

concerns.zh-CN: AI推理成本会不会吃掉节省？
concerns.en-US: Will AI inference cost eat the savings?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 过度乐观，低估合规与质量的约束
blindSpots.en-US: Overly optimistic, underestimating compliance and quality constraints

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不理解一线客服的信任问题
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand frontline agents' trust issues

text.zh-CN: 客服中心每月处理约18万张工单，其中55%是重复性的常见问题
text.en-US: The support center handles about 180,000 tickets a month, 55% of which are repetitive common issues

text.zh-CN: 当前工单流转依赖人工分级，平均首响时间为4小时，高峰期为9小时
text.en-US: Ticket routing relies on manual triage; average first-response is 4 hours, rising to 9 hours at peak

text.zh-CN: 人工成本占总支持预算的72%，且客服人员流失率每年达38%
text.en-US: Labor is 72% of the support budget, and agent attrition is 38% annually

text.zh-CN: 重复性工单让资深客服无法专注复杂问题，复杂工单的一次解决率只有51%
text.en-US: Repetitive tickets prevent senior agents from focusing on complex issues; first-contact resolution for complex tickets is only 51%

text.zh-CN: 现有规则引擎有3,400条硬编码规则，每季度需要两周人工维护，仍漏掉20%的新问题类型
text.en-US: The existing rule engine has 3,400 hard-coded rules needing two weeks of manual upkeep per quarter, yet misses 20% of new issue types

text.zh-CN: 规则无法理解自然语言变体，用户换个说法就匹配失败
text.en-US: Rules cannot understand natural-language variants; a rephrased question fails to match

text.zh-CN: 每次客户因等待过久而流失，预计终身价值损失约为320美元；每月约有900名客户因此流失
text.en-US: Each customer lost to long waits costs about $320 in lifetime value; about 900 customers churn monthly for this reason

text.zh-CN: 管理层预估，若自动化覆盖40%的工单，每年可节省约210万美元的直接成本
text.en-US: Management estimates that covering 40% of tickets with automation would save about $2.1 million annually in direct costs

text.zh-CN: 合规要求：涉及付款、退款和账户信息的工单必须保留人工复核，AI只能提供建议
text.en-US: Compliance requires human review for tickets involving payments, refunds, and account data; AI may only suggest

text.zh-CN: 数据隐私法规禁止将客户工单发送到境外第三方大模型，模型必须本地或境内部署
text.en-US: Data-privacy regulations forbid sending customer tickets to offshore third-party LLMs; the model must run on-premises or in-region

text.zh-CN: 目标是将平均首响时间从4小时降到1小时，同时把人工成本降低35%
text.en-US: The goal is to cut average first-response from 4 hours to 1 hour while reducing labor cost by 35%

text.zh-CN: 质量红线：自动化回答的准确率不得低于92%，且不能出现编造政策的情况
text.en-US: Quality floor: automated answers must be at least 92% accurate and must never fabricate policy

text.zh-CN: 一线客服担心AI抢走工作，抵触使用自动化建议，绕过系统直接人工回复
text.en-US: Frontline agents fear AI will take their jobs, resist using automated suggestions, and bypass the system to reply manually

text.zh-CN: 高管对AI的能力期望过高，认为可以一步到位实现全自动，低估了合规和质量的约束
text.en-US: Executives overestimate AI capability, expecting full automation in one step and underestimating compliance and quality constraints

text.zh-CN: AI在遇到不确定时会自信地编造一个退款政策，客户因此获得错误承诺
text.en-US: When uncertain, the AI confidently fabricates a refund policy, and customers receive wrong commitments

text.zh-CN: 如果自动化在高峰突然失效，人工队列会瞬间涌入上万张工单，导致服务雪崩
text.en-US: If automation suddenly fails at peak, tens of thousands of tickets flood the human queue at once, causing a service avalanche
